title: banksia heliantha
intro: Banksia heliantha, commonly known as the Leopard banksia, is a flowering plant native to Western Australia. This plant is known for its distinctive yellow and brown flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Banksia heliantha include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory conditions, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
